closedFindings.issue: Mandatory wire-length equality rejected chunked or transparently decompressed binary downloads.
closedFindings.resolution: Read bounded decoded bytes, accept missing Content-Length, compare wire length only for explicit identity encoding, cancel/release readers on failure/abort and bound native arrayBuffer fallback before file effects.
closedFindings.verification: Focused implementing-agent tests plus independent source reread; full current-source unit/API checks recorded separately.

closedFindings.issue: Cross-team transactions could race on a globally keyed device ID; INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING did not establish ownership. A hidden existing foreign row had the same unsafe postcondition.
closedFindings.resolution: Recheck exact committed device/account ownership after insert and fail409 before controller writes.

cases: Controlled barrier forces both initial device reads absent: one200/one409, one correct owner/grant and no losing idempotency receipt
Existing device hidden by cross-team RLS produces409 without a wrong-account grant
Same account can reuse its own device on another authorised team

hierarchyLimits: Only explicit actor match.manage transactions with bounded canonical resolved club/team/season/match IDs and manager/default role take shared global plus exclusive team locks.
Other explicit write transactions retain the original global exclusive lock. Existing row-locked worker claims were not globally locked and are unchanged.
Context cannot change operation/scope inside a transaction; unlocked read frames cannot upgrade to writes.
Same-team matches and seasons serialize; legacy/global writers interlock with all match transactions. Device ownership is checked independently.
limitations: Independent source review does not substitute for actual tests or runtime checks.
Three source-CI HEIC cases skip without the maintained decoder; actual image decoding and full configured host tests are separate evidence.
Report export jobs do not fulfill pending privacy requests; Q05/Q09/Q10 remain pending at user request.
Physical iPhone/Android behavior, production provider/hosting/push and the unresolved dependency gate remain release limits.
